continuous_injection_appendix_frozen.rule: the estimator is consumed CONTINUOUSLY, not only at the decision tick: on every controller frame the injector returns (mu_hat, sigma_total) where mu_hat = mean over the 3 members' means and sigma_total^2 = mean(sigma_m^2 + mu_m^2) - mu_hat^2 (mixture variance: aleatoric + epistemic/ensemble disagreement; the ensemble term is the distribution-shift detector)
continuous_injection_appendix_frozen.confidence_gate: the estimate is consumed iff sigma_total <= SIGMA_MAX = 0.12, frozen ex ante: the prior sd of mu ~ U(0.25,1.15) is 0.26 and the M3216 dataset-val GRU MAE spans 0.021-0.142, so consumption requires the model to CLAIM materially-better-than-prior, detector-scale accuracy; no eval-time tuning of this constant is permitted
continuous_injection_appendix_frozen.pre_reveal: when confident, the live estimate (clipped to [0.10,1.40]) is consumed by the seeker's entry-speed law (_v_target), force-limit estimate (_limit_est), and phase decisions; when not confident, the last confident estimate persists for at most STALE_MAX = 50 frames (1.0 s) and then expires; with no live estimate the controller falls back to its INTERNAL detector mu_hat / domain floor (bit-compatible belief-free behavior)
continuous_injection_appendix_frozen.at_reveal: at the first obstacle-present frame the belief FREEZES: mu_injected = the live confident estimate (current, or last-confident aged <= 50 frames); if none exists the episode keeps the internal detector for the reaction (mu_injected stays None)
continuous_injection_appendix_frozen.post_reveal: only the frozen value is consumed (mirror of the M3216 reveal-tick semantics; post-reveal braking/swerve frames are outside every training distribution and are never fed into a consumed estimate)
continuous_injection_appendix_frozen.fallback_design_intent: the gate makes the injected arm degrade GRACEFULLY to the floor seeker instead of overriding a competent internal detector with a shifted estimate (the measured M3216 failure mode at delay5/25/noise); it also bounds the residual on-policy shift: when the estimator is out of distribution the ensemble disagrees, the arm falls back, and the trajectory re-enters the no-belief family the closed-loop training half was collected from
continuous_injection_appendix_frozen.applies_to: both injected arms (L3_GRU primary, L0_frame leak control) with identical constants
continuous_injection_appendix_frozen.controller_hook: RampPolicyController gains injection_mode='continuous' (default 'decision_tick' is bit-compatible with M3216; existing hook tests must keep passing)

residual_limitations_declared: one DAgger-style step only: the eval-time injected seeker's trajectory differs from the no-belief collection seeker whenever the belief is consumed; this residual on-policy shift is part of the accepted bound, mitigated (not removed) by the confidence fallback
